edits.after: Name, relationships, body, home, consequences left by yesterday, and what must continue today come together again. We do not need to prove anew that these parts of the past belong to us, nor learn everything as though entering the world for the first time.
edits.reason: Naturalize the remembered parts of one's past; retain all grounds of continuity.
edits.before: Name, relationships, body, home, consequences left by yesterday, and what must continue today come together again. We do not need to prove anew that these pasts belong to us, nor learn everything as though entering the world for the first time.

edits.after: El nombre, las relaciones, el cuerpo, la vivienda, las consecuencias de ayer y lo que hay que continuar hoy vuelven a reunirse. No necesitamos demostrar otra vez que esas partes del pasado nos pertenecen ni aprenderlo todo como si entráramos por primera vez en el mundo.
edits.reason: Natural Spanish for parts of the past rather than multiple pasts.
edits.before: El nombre, las relaciones, el cuerpo, la vivienda, las consecuencias de ayer y lo que hay que continuar hoy vuelven a reunirse. No necesitamos demostrar otra vez que esos pasados nos pertenecen ni aprenderlo todo como si entráramos por primera vez en el mundo.

edits.after: Where does the “I” go during sleep? There may be no simple answer that fits our everyday experience.
edits.reason: Repair awkward question nesting while retaining the open question and everyday scope.
edits.before: There may be no simple answer suited to everyday experience to where the “I” goes during sleep.

edits.after: Others can describe what they saw of us, but that does not give them the whole interpretation of that life. Even when we cannot remember, we can still judge external accounts: which evidence is reliable, which is only a story formed afterward, and which parts can never be confirmed.
edits.reason: Naturalize the us they saw without granting observers complete interpretive authority.
edits.before: Others can describe the us they saw, but that does not give them the whole interpretation of that life. Even when we cannot remember, we can still judge external accounts: which evidence is reliable, which is only a story formed afterward, and which parts can never be confirmed.

edits.after: It requires that when those gaps leave real consequences, we remain willing to take up what can be confirmed, rather than acknowledge only the parts of the past we still remember.
edits.reason: Natural prose for remembered parts of a single life.
edits.before: It requires that when those gaps leave real consequences, we remain willing to take up what can be confirmed, rather than acknowledge only the pasts we still remember.

edits.after: Exige que, cuando esos huecos dejan consecuencias reales, sigamos dispuestos a asumir lo que pueda confirmarse, en lugar de reconocer únicamente las partes del pasado que todavía recordamos.
edits.reason: Naturalize los pasados while preserving responsibility for confirmable consequences.
edits.before: Exige que, cuando esos huecos dejan consecuencias reales, sigamos dispuestos a asumir lo que pueda confirmarse, en lugar de reconocer únicamente los pasados que todavía recordamos.

edits.after: No podemos comparar sin más a alguien que por un tiempo no sabe qué quiere hacer a continuación con alguien que entra en una habitación y olvida qué iba a buscar. La orientación a largo plazo implica valores, relaciones y condiciones reales: no se recupera automáticamente con solo volver al punto de partida.
edits.reason: Repair the person-versus-action comparison; retain the explicit limit on the analogy.
edits.before: No podemos comparar sin más a alguien que por un tiempo no sabe qué quiere hacer a continuación con entrar en una habitación y olvidar qué se iba a buscar. La orientación a largo plazo implica valores, relaciones y condiciones reales: no se recupera automáticamente con solo volver al punto de partida.

edits.after: Body, memory, relationships, objects, law, and daily arrangements all join the two moments. More importantly, we are willing today to take up what yesterday left behind.
edits.reason: Avoid the unnatural today's selves while retaining first-person continuity.
edits.before: Body, memory, relationships, objects, law, and daily arrangements all join the two moments. More importantly, today's selves are willing to take up what yesterday left behind.

edits.after: Asumir responsabilidades mantiene conectado al yo que cambia.
edits.reason: Give asumir its intended object: taking responsibility, not an unspecified assumption.
edits.before: Asumir mantiene conectado al yo que cambia.

edits.after: This continuation is sometimes very smooth and sometimes undergoes rupture. Some parts of the past are hard to recognize again, and some changes make others feel as though a different person stood before them. But as long as someone can still say, “That really happened in my life, and I must now decide how to take responsibility and continue,” continuity does not depend on every detail remaining unchanged.
edits.reason: Naturalize some pasts while preserving the full qualification about rupture and continuity.
edits.before: This continuation is sometimes very smooth and sometimes undergoes rupture. Some pasts are hard to recognize again, and some changes make others feel as though a different person stood before them. But as long as someone can still say, “That really happened in my life, and I must now decide how to take responsibility and continue,” continuity does not depend on every detail remaining unchanged.

edits.after: Esta continuidad a veces es muy estable y otras atraviesa rupturas. Algunas partes del pasado son difíciles de reconocer y algunos cambios hacen sentir a los demás que tienen delante a otra persona. Pero mientras alguien pueda decir «eso sí ocurrió en mi vida, y ahora debo decidir cómo asumirlo y continuar», la continuidad no dependerá de que todos los detalles permanezcan iguales.
edits.reason: Natural Spanish for parts of the past; preserve every qualification.
edits.before: Esta continuidad a veces es muy estable y otras atraviesa rupturas. Algunos pasados son difíciles de reconocer y algunos cambios hacen sentir a los demás que tienen delante a otra persona. Pero mientras alguien pueda decir «eso sí ocurrió en mi vida, y ahora debo decidir cómo asumirlo y continuar», la continuidad no dependerá de que todos los detalles permanezcan iguales.

edits.after: Some parts of the past already belong to us whether we like them or not. Consequences already caused cannot be canceled by “no longer identifying with who I was then.” Other directions need to be reaffirmed. Having once wanted to do something does not mean a person must continue every day thereafter. Continuity is not renewing every old desire forever.
edits.reason: Naturalize some pasts without weakening the distinction between consequences and revisable goals.
edits.before: Some pasts already belong to us whether we like them or not. Consequences already caused cannot be canceled by “no longer identifying with who I was then.” Other directions need to be reaffirmed. Having once wanted to do something does not mean a person must continue every day thereafter. Continuity is not renewing every old desire forever.

edits.after: Algunas partes del pasado ya nos pertenecen, nos gusten o no. Las consecuencias causadas no se anulan porque «ya no me identifico con quien era». Otras direcciones necesitan confirmarse de nuevo. Haber querido hacer algo no obliga a continuarlo todos los días posteriores: la continuidad no es renovar para siempre todos los deseos antiguos.
edits.reason: Natural Spanish for the parts of one's past.
edits.before: Algunos pasados ya nos pertenecen, nos gusten o no. Las consecuencias causadas no se anulan porque «ya no me identifico con quien era». Otras direcciones necesitan confirmarse de nuevo. Haber querido hacer algo no obliga a continuarlo todos los días posteriores: la continuidad no es renovar para siempre todos los deseos antiguos.

edits.after: No one can remember the whole past or keep every former direction going. What truly matters is whether gaps are honestly acknowledged, whether someone still takes up consequences that can be confirmed, and whether, in making new choices, we are willing to face conditions left by the old life.
edits.reason: People, not choices themselves, are willing to face consequences; preserve all three tests.
edits.before: No one can remember the whole past or keep every former direction going. What truly matters is whether gaps are honestly acknowledged, whether someone still takes up consequences that can be confirmed, and whether new choices are willing to face conditions left by the old life.

edits.after: Consiste en permitir que los yoes de distintos momentos se corrijan mutuamente sin expulsar por completo a ninguno de la vida.
edits.reason: Use the standard Spanish plural yoes for successive selves.
edits.before: Consiste en permitir que los yo de distintos momentos se corrijan mutuamente sin expulsar por completo a ninguno de la vida.

edits.after: Rather, each time we return, we can still acknowledge that some parts of the past belong to us, remain willing to take up certain unfinished things, and retain the ability to decide anew how to hand today over to the future.
edits.reason: Naturalize pasts while retaining all three conditions of reconnection.
edits.before: Rather, each time we return, we can still acknowledge that some pasts belong to us, remain willing to take up certain unfinished things, and retain the ability to decide anew how to hand today over to the future.

edits.after: Lo somos porque cada vez que regresamos todavía podemos reconocer que ciertas partes del pasado nos pertenecen, aceptar algunos asuntos pendientes y decidir de nuevo cómo entregar hoy al futuro.
edits.reason: Natural Spanish for parts of one's past, retaining unfinished responsibilities and renewed choice.
edits.before: Lo somos porque cada vez que regresamos todavía podemos reconocer que ciertos pasados nos pertenecen, aceptar algunos asuntos pendientes y decidir de nuevo cómo entregar hoy al futuro.
